title: Nandati
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Nandati puttehi puttimā || gomiko gohi tath-eva nandati || upadhīhi narassa nandanā || na hi so nandati yo nirupadhīti || || Socati puttehi puttimā || gomiko gohi tath-eva socati || upadhīhi narassa socanā || na hi socati yo nirupadhīti || ||
